about_the_game:
Enter the nebula. Power up your thrusters. Become the last line of defense.

Nebula Invaders is a 2D arcade action game where every move, every shot, and every explosion matters. Pilot a fast and responsive spaceship through a minimalist starfield and take on waves of colorful enemies, each with unique shapes and attack patterns.

Destroy invaders to collect bonuses, upgrade your weapons, and challenge powerful bosses whose defeat will grant you even greater ship enhancements. No story, no mercy—just you, your reflexes, and a dazzling neon storm in the endless void.

Key Features:

  • 🌠 Fast-paced, fluid arcade gameplay

  • ⚙️ Ship and weapon upgrade system

  • 👾 Intense boss battles

  • 💫 Neon aesthetic inspired by TRON and classic arcade shooters

  • 🕹️ Progressive difficulty for an ever-growing challenge

Whether you’re a nostalgic fan of retro shooters or simply looking for a thrilling, hypnotic action experience, Nebula Invaders will pull you into a cosmic dance of light and destruction where precision is survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10-11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-2500K ou AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 ou AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10-11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-8400 ou AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 ou AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Nebula Invaders is a retro-neon space shooter where you pilot a lone ship against endless waves of interstellar invaders. Destroy, dodge, upgrade your weapons, and survive in a vibrant cosmic battlefield!
